name: Igorri
blurb: Experimenters, scientists and travelling physicians fallen into the darker sciences. Skilled surgeons who meld flesh like clay in pursuit of the Greater Form — a tight-knit family of six deformed physician houses pacted to the Multi-Coloured Devil.

specialMechanic.name: Spare Parts
specialMechanic.text: If an ability has spare parts, the unit may absorb any number of adjacent corpses at the start of the ability for additional effects, removing those corpses.

specialTags.Mutate: When a unit mutates, it gains a mutation token. Mutation tokens can be discarded in place of any other token, and can stand in as a copy of any token.
specialTags.Corpse: When a unit dies it leaves a corpse marker; corpses can stack and be created by other means.

traits.name: Polyglot
traits.text: At turn start, may convert one mutation token into strength, speed or vitality, then mutate.

acts.name: Experimental Surgery
acts.text: Line 4: 1 damage. Allies in the line mutate instead of taking damage.

souls.name: Wild Mutation
souls.text: Turn start: unit gains 1 strength, (3-4) or 1 speed, (5-6) or 1 vitality. Spare Parts: choose one per corpse instead of rolling.

souls.name: Sample Genome
souls.text: Copy all positive tokens on a target, then grant them to another unit in range.

traits.name: Fall to Shambles
traits.text: When slain, leaves an extra corpse token in an adjacent space (two corpses total).

traits.name: Thrall
traits.text: 2 per unit slot; may activate two at a time.

acts.name: Unstable Mutation
acts.text: Gain 1 strength, (4+) 1 speed, (5+) and 1 vitality, (6+) and explode for splash (self) 1 damage. Spare Parts: roll +1D per corpse, pick highest.

upgrades.name: Spread Mutate
upgrades.text: Twisting Strike gains effect (5+): steal a positive token from target.

upgrades.name: Warping Mutate
upgrades.text: Twisting Strike also causes an adjacent ally to mutate.

upgrades.name: The Hunger
upgrades.text: If starting turn in range 2 of a corpse, may step 2.

traits.name: Hunch
traits.text: May use corpses as cover spaces.

acts.name: Inject Mutagen
acts.text: One or two units in range mutate. Spare Parts: also dole out 1 strength per corpse consumed.

acts.name: Purge
acts.text: A unit removes one token of this unit's choice, (3+) two, (5+) all.

acts.name: Marriage
acts.text: Instantly slay self or an allied unit in range. Another ally in range gains 2 speed, vitality and strength (or 1 each if the slain unit was a thrall).

upgrades.name: Genestealer
upgrades.text: May grant one of the tokens stolen by Purge to another unit in range.

upgrades.name: Autophagia
upgrades.text: At turn start, may deal 1 damage to self (ignoring armor) to generate a corpse in an adjacent space.

upgrades.name: Conjoin
upgrades.text: If targeting self, Marriage also clears all negative tokens on target first.

traits.name: Lope
traits.text: Has free movement and ignores hazards in spaces occupied by corpses.

acts.name: Bloodgorger
acts.text: Mutate, then gain 1 strength. Spare Parts: then gain (3+) 1 speed, (5+) and 1 vitality, (6+) then mutate again. Roll +1D per corpse, pick highest.

acts.name: Bloody Slashes
acts.text: On hit: 1 damage. Then splash (self): 1 damage.

upgrades.name: Scour Flesh
upgrades.text: May step 1 (4+) or 3 spaces before Unstable/Bloodgorger.

upgrades.name: Absorb
upgrades.text: Purge deals 1 piercing toxic damage to foes.

upgrades.name: Sticky Lope
upgrades.text: During free movement over corpses, may create a corpse in a space passed through.

traits.name: Leftovers
traits.text: After MOVEing, drop a corpse in a free adjacent space.

traits.name: Flight
traits.text: Ignores adverse terrain and elevation attack and movement penalties.

acts.name: Regurgitate
acts.text: Splash (target): create a corpse in the area for every unit in the area, up to three times, then mutate.

acts.name: Sin Eater
acts.text: On hit: 1 damage. Steal a positive token from target (or gain 1 strength if it has none). Spare Parts: steal 1 more per corpse consumed.

upgrades.name: Drown in Viscera
upgrades.text: Regurgitate has a 5+ effect chance to strip a token of your choice from each foe in the area.

upgrades.name: Rapid Adaptation
upgrades.text: May mutate once for each corpse created with Regurgitate instead.

upgrades.name: Cleansing Wash
upgrades.text: Regurgitate has a 5+ chance to remove a negative token from an ally caught in the area.

traits.name: Tyrant
traits.text: 2x2 unit. Large: ignores elevation, cannot take cover, affected by terrain once.

acts.name: Sculpt Flesh
acts.text: Gain 1 strength, OR 1 speed, OR 1 vitality. Spare Parts: repeat once per corpse consumed.

acts.name: Absorb
acts.text: Deal 1 devil damage to an adjacent unit. If reduced to 0 hp, it is obliterated and this unit gains any tokens it had.

acts.name: Flesh Whip
acts.text: On hit: 1 damage and splash (target): 1 damage and create one or (5+) two corpses adjacent to target.

upgrades.name: Meld
upgrades.text: When choosing to MOVE again, destroys walls and absorbs corpses it moves over, mutating each time.

upgrades.name: Form Carapace
upgrades.text: If Absorb destroys a unit, gains physical armor for the rest of combat.

upgrades.name: Ball of Limbs
upgrades.text: When absorbing allies, slays instead of obliterating them, and this unit mutates.
